_purpose: The exact configuration of the reported run. scripts/run_all.sh uses these values; changing them means re-running everything and replacing results/metrics/*.

dataset._units: pressure in psia, temperature in degrees Rankine (T[F] + 460), F_V dimensionless
dataset._pT_window_source: span of the flash states printed in Models/3 - ..., pp. 14-18

training.model_selection: parameters at the epoch of lowest validation DATA MSE (same criterion for both variants)
training.lambda: measured on the training split: the value making the data and physics terms equal for the training-mean predictor

evaluation.timing: median of 15 repetitions after 3 warm-ups, both vectorised over the whole test set
evaluation.summary_statistics: mean and population standard deviation (ddof=0) over the three seeds of each per-seed metric
